display_long_description:
Once upon a time, the monsters got out of the storybooks. Time to punch them back in.

Team up with up to 10 friends online or play solo in a bright storybook world full of goblins, trolls, pirates and sea monsters.

REAL FIGHTING
Your fists are your controllers. The faster you swing, the harder you hit. Guard, land combos and stagger the big ones.

WEAR THE LEGENDS
Bosses drop magic masks. Put one on and become that legend: spin the Monkey King's staff, throw monsters as Grimclaw or call down lightning as Stormcaller. Masks level up, unlock abilities and come in six rarities, from Common to Fable.

ANIMAL COMPANIONS
Weaken a wild squirrel, rabbit, kitten, puppy or rare baby dragon, catch it in a basket and heal it at home. Your companion fights beside you and rides along in your car or boat.

A WORLD TO EXPLORE
Explore the Wildwood, Frostpeak and the Sunken Isles and take on more than twenty bosses, including the Goblin King, the Yeti King and the Kraken.

HANG OUT AT HOME
Paint your house and save your favourite looks, climb your Treehouse, dress up in capes and sweaters, and boost your bike, hot rod or boat.

FAIR AND FREE
Free to play. Everything you fight with is earned by playing. Nothing you buy is random, and it's never pay-to-win.

EARLY ACCESS
More legends, places and companions are on the way. Tell us what you think!

COMFORT YOUR WAY
Play standing or roomscale. Move with your arms or the thumbstick, with snap or smooth turning and comfort vignettes.
